### Observed differences

- Activity A01 was not observed at all in the earlier window (0 of 200 traces, no observed outgoing transitions); in the later window it runs in about 101 of 200 traces (roughly 50 in 100), about 1.1 times per trace, at a median position about a third of the way into the trace. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001]
- In the later window, A01's observed outgoing transitions go mainly to A05 (about 35 in 100), A03 (about 19) and A06 (about 15), with smaller shares to A15, A16, A10 and A12. [DIR001]
- Activities that never led to A01 before now do: in the later window about 36 in 100 of A09's observed outgoing transitions go to A01, about 28 in 100 of A08's, about 22 in 100 of A06's, about 11 in 100 of A12's and about 7 in 100 of A05's; none did before. [DIR006, DIR005, DIR004, DIR007, DIR003]
- Every measured A01 pair moved from never co-occurring to co-occurring in roughly a third to a half of traces: with A05 and A12 about 50 in 100, with A09 about 46, with A08 about 40, and with A03, A06 and A15 about 32–34; before, these partners appeared without A01 in about 33–66 in 100 traces. In six of the seven pairs A01 comes first more often than the reverse (e.g., before A12 in 22 vs 3.5 in 100); only with A08 does the reverse slightly prevail (9 vs 4 in 100). [REL002, REL006, REL005, REL004, REL001, REL003, REL007]
- Step distances between existing pairs were redistributed, mostly to larger lags: A09→A03 and A08→A03, which followed within one step in about half of the cases before, never did in the later window (lags spread over 2–5 steps), and lags of 4–5 steps appeared for A08→A05, A09→A12 and A08→A12; A03→A08 moved the other way, from lag 5 (about 43 in 100) to mostly lag 2 (about 40 in 100). These rest on moderate support (roughly 34–71 traces per window). [LAG005, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG007, LAG001]
- Outgoing shares also shifted at two activities without A01 involved: at A03, transitions to A05 fell from about 44 to 27 in 100 while those to A12 rose from about 1 to 17; at A16, transitions to A02 rose from about 8 to 43 in 100 while those to A05 fell from about 34 to 10. [DIR002, DIR008]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that A01 was introduced into the process flow in the later window and now executes between existing activities: an activity absent from the earlier window runs in about half of the later traces, about a third of the way through each trace, typically after activities such as A08, A09, A12 or A06 and before activities such as A05, A03 or A06. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007]

The change is shown directly (participation from zero to about 50 in 100, newly observed edges into and out of A01, co-occurrence rising from never to a third-to-half of traces with A01 usually first), it is consistent across every A01-related item, and the 25 qualifying control-flow items far exceed the fewer than one expected if nothing had changed, so the pattern as a whole is not what an unchanged process typically produces. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008]

Limitations: zero participation in the earlier window strictly establishes only that A01 was not observed then, not that it could not occur; the evidence also cannot determine whether A01 sits at one fixed point or in several alternative paths, since it follows several different predecessors. A competing explanation it cannot rule out is that the routing shifts at A03 and A16 are independent changes rather than consequences of A01's appearance. [OCC001, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR002, DIR008]

Other differences: the successor mix changed at A03 (A05 down from about 44 to 27 in 100 of its outgoing transitions, A12 up from about 1 to 17) and at A16 (A02 up from about 8 to 43, A05 down from about 34 to 10), without A01 being involved. [DIR002, DIR008]
